metadata.short_desc: Use DeepSeek through a persistent browser for web search and deep thinking.
metadata.desc: Use browser_operator's persistent browser to call DeepSeek for web search, deep thinking, and multi-turn conversations.

astrbot_plugin_deepseek_search.hint: Configure browser-mode behavior for deepseek_search and deepseek_multi_turn. Web search state is controlled by the current DeepSeek page.

enable_expert.description: Switch to Expert for deep thinking
enable_expert.hint: On: deep_think=true also switches to Expert. Off: enables deep thinking without switching Expert. Search/web-search state is unchanged.
